events.text: User ruled: don't bolt React Scene3D back over the loader (jank + reintroduces 683MB invisibly). Proper path = host-side overlays or 2D projected HUD. See handoff brief.

resolution: Companion to req_1792: the loader iso pane's editing-feedback layer. Added IsoStage.project() (world->screen, the analytic inverse of pieceRay, reusing GAME_CAMERA.worldToScreen) and a 2D projected HUD overlay in LoaderIsoView that draws the armed placement ghost as a wireframe box and every selected piece's footprint outline, using the meshSelect.tsx pattern (Graph.Polyline segments in an identity-view Graph with pointerEvents off). The overlay is projected through the SAME iso solve the native loader renders with, so the ghost/selection track the camera on drag/pan/zoom (pushCamera triggers a rerender while something is on the HUD). No React Scene3D is reintroduced — the hard line the user drew. CatalogRail/sameArmed/Armed exported from IsoAuthor for reuse; index.tsx feeds LoaderIsoView the same editing props it gives IsoAuthor. Deferred to follow-ups: tower drag-shell, drag-paint walls/floors, rotate/clone of a placed selection, ctrl-vertical prop move.
